d: 1977 men grahon ki ek aisi durlabh sthiti bani, jisne nasa ko aise antriksh yan bhejne ka mauqa diya, jo hamare saurmandal ke bahri chhoron aur usse bhi aage ki khoj kar sakte the. in antriksh yanon men ek sone ki parat charhi huee disk bhi rakhi gaee thi. ismen prithvi ki aavazen, sangit aur tasviren thin. ise antriksh men maujud sanbhavit eliyan sabhyataon ke lie ek sandesh ke taur par taiyar kiya gaya tha.
